batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2019-2020, Set-A — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.61-64 (questions; printed answer table at the head of p.64; printed worked solutions pp.64-65). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper (only 'Short Syllabus' and 'Extra Syllabus' boxes); subject blocks by printed layout/content: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, General Knowledge Q7-12, ICT Q13-14, Physics Q15-36, Chemistry Q37-58, Higher Mathematics Q59-80. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order: Q29, 30, 31, 36, 46, 47, 52, 53 appear under the 'Extra Syllabus' box on p.63 and Q57-61, 72, 74, 79 on p.64 before the answer table. The answer table prints dashes at Q25 and Q34, and for both the printed worked solutions (book PDF p.64) explicitly state '(No answer)' — Q25 computes the impulse as 18 kgms^-1, which is not among the printed options; Q34's solution states two or more atoms can be isotones of each other — so both carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds []; their answerVerificationStatus is 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. No dual keys occur in this paper. Worked solutions are printed for 36 questions (05, 06, 15, 18-26, 33, 34, 54, 55, 59-65, 67-71, 73-80 selective); every printed solution letter agrees with the answer table. Preserved print anomalies: Q25's option values exclude the book's own computed answer; Q51(c) prints a vertical bond stroke above the C; Q72 and Q79 print the option label 'b)' without its opening parenthesis; Q2's radical vinculum extends over the following syllable in each option; Q40 and Q56 are physics-flavoured items printed inside the Chemistry block and Q47 is printed inside the Chemistry Extra-Syllabus block (subjects follow the printed block position). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-A of JU A Unit 2019-2020 occupies book PDF pp.61-64 (printed book pp.60-63): questions pp.61-64, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') at the head of p.64, printed worked solutions pp.64-65. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page (zoomed re-reads for the Q1/Q2 spellings, the Q25 option digits, the Q30 stem, the Q34 nuclide options, the Q39 ion options, the Q45 statement list, the Q49/Q50 options and the Q51 option (c) bond stroke); mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices as [[... , ...], ...], determinants wrapped in |...|, nuclides as ^<mass>_<atomic number><symbol>).
